name: Lay on Hands
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Aura Mastery
description:
Empowers your chosen aura for 8 sec.

Devotion Aura: Damage reduction increased to 12%.

Crusader Aura: Mount speed bonus increased to 60%.

Concentration Aura: Affected allies immune to interrupts and silences.

name: Blessing of Sacrifice
description: Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.\n\nLast 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

name: Blinding Light
description: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Turn Evil
description: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.

name: Blessing of Protection
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Divine Steed
description: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.

name: Eternal Flame
description: Heals an ally for 1,436 and an additional 465 over 16 sec.\n\nHealing increased by 25% when cast on self.

name: Holy Armaments
description:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

name: Holy Shock
description: Triggers a burst of Light on the target, dealing 811 Holy damage to an enemy, or 2,554 healing to an ally.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Light of Dawn
description: Unleashes Holy energy, healing up to 5 injured allies within a 40 yd radius around you for 1,925.

name: Avenging Wrath
description: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec.

name: Avenging Crusader
description:
You become the ultimate crusader of light, for 15 sec. Auto-attack damage is increased by 1,000%, Judgment and Crusader Strike heal up to 5 injured allies within 40 yds for 80% of the damage done, split evenly among them.

This spell is replaced with Crusader Strike while active.

Crusader Strike:
Strike the target for 49 Physical damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.

name: Divine Toll
description: Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

name: Holy Prism
description:
Fires a beam of light that scatters to strike a clump of targets. 

If the beam is aimed at an enemy target, it deals 2,501 Holy damage and radiates 2,555 healing to 5 allies within 30 yds.

If the beam is aimed at a friendly target, it heals for 6,037 and radiates 944 Holy damage to 5 enemies within 30 yds.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

name: Beacon of Virtue
description: Apply a Beacon of Light to your target and 4 injured allies within 30 yds for 9 sec.\n\nAll affected allies will be healed for 10% of the amount of your other healing done.

name: Blessing of Freedom
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.

name: Beacon of Faith
description: Mark a second target as a Beacon, mimicking the effects of Beacon of Light. Your heals will now heal both of your Beacons, but at 30% reduced effectiveness.

name: Rite of Adjuration
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.\n\nLasts 1 hour.

name: Rite of Sanctification
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.\n\nLasts 1 hour.

name: Intercession
description: Petition the Light on the behalf of a fallen ally, restoring spirit to body and allowing them to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

name: Divine Shield
description: Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. \n\nCannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Jailer's Judgment
description: Stuns the target Player for 6 sec. If the judgment holds for 6 sec, the enemy will be instantly teleported to your jail. Can only be used while in Ashran.

name: Tyr's Deliverance
description: Releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.\n\nAllies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.

name: Divine Protection
description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.

name: Eye of Tyr
description: Releases a blinding flash from Truthguard, causing 19 Holy damage to all nearby enemies within 8 yds and reducing all damage they deal to you by 25% for 9 sec.

name: Hammer of Justice
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

name: Wake of Ashes
description: Lash out with the Ashbringer, dealing 61 Radiant damage to all enemies within 12 yd in front of you, and reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.\n\nDemon and Undead enemies are stunned for 6 sec if struck by the Wake of Ashes.

name: Cleanse
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Cleanse Toxins
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects..

name: Contemplation
description: Allows you a moment of peace as you kneel in quiet contemplation to ponder the nature of the Light.

name: Shield of the Righteous
description: Slams enemies in front of you with your shield, causing 33 Holy damage, and increasing your Armor by 608 for 4.5 sec.

name: Absolution
description: Returns all dead party members to life with 35% of maximum health and mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Ancient Fury
description: Unleash the fury of ancient kings, causing 10 Holy damage per application of Ancient Power, divided evenly among all targets within 10 yards.

name: Ardent Defender
description: Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.\n\nWhile Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.

name: Beacon of Light
description: Wrap a single ally in holy energy, causing your direct healing on other party or raid members to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.

name: Consecration
description: Deals 1 Holy damage every 0.9 sec to enemies within 8 yards.

name: Crusader Aura
description: Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.

name: Crusader Strike
description: Strike the target for 49 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Crusader's Direhorn
description: Summons a Crusader's Direhorn, which serves as a mount.

name: Devotion Aura
description: Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
description: Summons the Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith, which serves as a mount.

name: Flash of Light
description: Quickly heal a friendly target for 1,204.

name: Hammer of Wrath
description: Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 51 Holy damage.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Hand of Reckoning
description: Commands the attention of an enemy target, forcing them to attack you and increasing the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Holy Light
description: A powerful but expensive spell, healing a friendly target for 12,442.

name: Judgment
description: Judges the target, dealing 258 Holy damage.

name: Light of the Ancient Kings
description: Heals the target of your heals for 30% of the amount healed.

name: Light's Hammer
description: Hurls a Light-infused hammer to the ground, dealing 77 Holy damage to nearby enemies and healing up to 6 nearby allies for 181, every 2 sec for 14 sec.

name: Protector of the Innocent
description: Casting a targeted heal on any target, except yourself, also heals you for 20.

name: Redemption
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Retribution Aura
description: When any party or raid member within 40 yds takes more than 30% of their health in damage in a single hit, each member gains 5% increased damage and healing, decaying over 30 sec. This cannot occur within 30 sec of the aura being applied.

name: Sense Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Summon Charger
description: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Darkforge Ram
description: Summons a Darkforge Ram, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Dawnforge Ram
description: Summons a Dawnforge Ram, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Exarch's Elekk
description: Summons an Exarch's Elekk, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Great Exarch's Elekk
description: Summons an Great Exarch's Elekk, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Great Sunwalker Kodo
description: Summons a Great Sunwalker Kodo, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Lightforged Ruinstrider
description: Summons a Lightforged Ruinstrider, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Sunwalker Kodo
description: Summons a Sunwalker Kodo, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Thalassian Charger
description: Summons a Thalassian Charger, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Thalassian Warhorse
description: Summons a Thalassian Warhorse, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Warhorse
description: Summons a Warhorse, which serves as a mount.

name: Word of Glory
description: Calls down the Light to heal a friendly target for 1,604.

name: Searing Glare
description: Call upon the light to blind enemy players in a 25 yd cone, causing enemies to miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec.

name: Blessing of Spellwarding
description:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

name: Cleanse the Weak
description: When you Cleanse an ally, 1 ally within 40 yds is dispelled of the same effects, but the cooldown of Cleanse is increased by 4 sec.\n\nHealing allies with your Flash of Light or Holy Light will cleanse all Diseases and Poisons from the target.

name: Darkest before the Dawn
description: Every 5 sec the healing done by your next Light of Dawn is increased by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Denounce
description: Casts down the enemy with a bolt of Holy Light, causing 2,899 Holy damage and preventing the target from causing critical effects for the next 8 sec.

name: Divine Plea
description: After casting Aura Mastery, you restore 6,428 Mana over 30 sec, but your healing and damage is decreased by 30%.

name: Divine Vision
description: Increases the range of your Aura by 30 yards and reduces the cooldown of Aura Mastery by 30 sec.

name: Luminescence
description: Lightbearer's healing transfer is increased by up to 150% based on your current health. Lower health heals allies for more.

name: Shining Revelation
description: The light reveals all enemies in stealth or invisible to you while under the effects of Divine Shield. This effect lingers for 20 sec after Divine Shield fades.

name: Spellbreaker
description: Eye for an Eye can now also trigger at 100% effectiveness from direct Magic damage.

name: Spreading the Word
description:
Your allies affected by your Aura gain an effect after you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Freedom.

 Blessing of Protection
Physical damage reduced by 30% for 6 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom
Cleared of all movement impairing effects.

name: Ultimate Sacrifice
description: Your Blessing of Sacrifice now transfers 100% of all damage to you into a damage over time effect, but lasts 6 sec and no longer cancels when you are below 20% health.

name: A Just Reward
description: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 2,052.

name: Afterimage
description: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.

name: Armory of Light
description: While holding a shield, you have a 15% chance to block incoming spells, reducing their damage by 20%. \n\nWithout a shield, you have a 15% chance to parry incoming melee attacks, reducing their damage by 20%.

name: Auras of the Resolute
description:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.

name: Aurora
description:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.

name: Authoritative Rebuke
description: Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament.

name: Awakening
description: While in combat, your Holy Power spenders have a 10% chance to cause your next Judgment to deal 30% increased damage and critically strike.\n\nActivating Avenging Wrath activates Awakening.

name: Awestruck
description: Holy Shock, Holy Light, and Flash of Light critical healing increased by 20%.

name: Beacon of the Lightbringer
description: Mastery: Lightbringer now increases your healing based on the target's proximity to either you or your Beacon of Light, whichever is closer.

name: Beacon of the Savior
description: While in combat, apply a Beacon of the Savior to the lowest health ally within 30 yds that causes your direct healing on others to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.\n\nBeacon of the Savior transfers to the lowest health ally within 30 yds if it heals a target past maximum health or if an ally drops below 50% health.

name: Bestow Light
description: Light of the Martyr's health threshold is reduced to 70% and increases Holy Shock's healing by an additional 5% for every 5 sec Light of the Martyr is active, stacking up to 3 times.\n\nWhile below 70% health, the light urgently heals you for 76 every 1 sec.

name: Blessed Assurance
description: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 200%.

name: Blessed Calling
description: Allies affected by your Blessings have 15% increased movement speed.

name: Blessing of An'she
description: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.

name: Blessing of Dawn
description: While you are above 85% health, 5% of all damage taken by allies within 20 yds is redirected to you, up to a maximum of 1,527 every 5 sec.

name: Blessing of Dusk
description: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.

name: Blessing of the Forge
description: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.

name: Born in Sunlight
description: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.

name: Breaking Dawn
description: Increases Light of Dawn's healing by 5%.

name: Brought to Light
description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor causes you to explode with holy energy, healing up to 5 nearby allies and yourself for 175, split evenly among them.

name: Call of the Righteous
description: Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec.\n\nAvenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 30.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 3.0 sec.

name: Cavalier
description: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.

name: Commanding Light
description: Beacon of Light transfers an additional 5% of the amount healed.

name: Consecrated Ground
description: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.

name: Crusader's Might
description: Holy Shock reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec and Crusader Strike reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec.

name: Dawnlight
description:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.

name: Divine Favor
description: The mana cost of Holy Light is reduced by 10% and its cast time is reduced by 15%.

name: Divine Glimpse
description: Holy Shock and Judgment have a 8% increased critical strike chance.

name: Divine Guidance
description: For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 1,140 damage or healing immediately, split across all enemies and allies.

name: Divine Inspiration
description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.

name: Divine Overload
description: Holy Light's healing is increased by 30%, but its mana cost is increased by 20%.

name: Divine Purpose
description: Holy Power spending abilities have a 15% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 15% increased damage and healing.

name: Divine Reach
description: The radius of your auras is increased by 20 yds.

name: Divine Resonance
description: After casting Holy Prism, Holy Armament, or Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.

name: Divine Revelations
description: While empowered by Infusion of Light, Flash of Light heals for an additional 20% and Judgment refunds 0.5% of your maximum mana.

name: Divine Spurs
description: Divine Steed's cooldown is reduced by 20%, but its duration is reduced by 40%.

name: Echoing Blessings
description: Blessing of Freedom increases the target's movement speed by 30%. Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Sacrifice reduce the target's damage taken by 15%. These effects linger for 8 sec after the Blessing ends.

name: Empyreal Ward
description: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.

name: Empyrean Legacy
description: Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.

name: Endless Gleam
description: Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.

name: Extrication
description: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn gain up to 30% additional chance to critically strike, based on their target's current health. Lower health targets are more likely to be critically struck.

name: Eye for an Eye
description: Melee and ranged attackers receive 133 Holy damage each time they strike you during Divine Protection and Divine Shield.

name: Faith's Armor
description: Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.

name: Fear No Evil
description: Fear duration on you reduced by 20%. This effect is increased to 60% during Avenging Wrath.

name: Fist of Justice
description: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Forewarning
description: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.

name: Gleaming Rays
description: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.

name: Glistening Radiance
description: While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 1% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 5%.

name: Glorious Dawn
description: Holy Shock has a 12% chance to refund a charge when cast and its healing is increased by 10%.

name: Golden Path
description: Consecration heals you and 5 allies within it for 2 every 0.9 sec.

name: Greater Judgment
description: Judgment deems the target unworthy, preventing the next 1,835 damage dealt by the target.

name: Guided Prayer
description: When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

name: Hammer and Anvil
description: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.

name: Hand of Divinity
description: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next 2 Holy Lights to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.

name: Holy Aegis
description: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.

name: Holy Reprieve
description: Your Forbearance's duration is reduced by 10 sec.

name: Holy Ritual
description: Allies are healed for 7,552 when you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice on them.

name: Illumine
description: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.

name: Imbued Infusions
description: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 1.0 sec.

name: Improved Blessing of Protection
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 sec.

name: Improved Cleanse
description: Cleanse additionally removes all Disease and Poison effects.

name: Inflorescence of the Sunwell
description: Infusion of Light has 1 additional charge.

name: Infusion of Light
description:
Your Holy Shocks have a 10% chance to empower your next spell cast:

Flash of Light: healing increased by 200% and becomes instant cast.
Judgment: Greater Judgment prevents an additional 150% damage dealt by the target and generates 1 additional Holy Power.

name: Inspired Guard
description: Divine Protection increases healing taken by 15% for its duration.

name: Laying Down Arms
description: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.

name: Lead the Charge
description: Divine Steed reduces the cooldown of 4 nearby ally's major movement ability by 3.0 sec.\n\nYour movement speed is increased by 3%.

name: Liberation
description: 12% of Word of Glory and Light of Dawn's healing is converted into Holy damage that strikes a nearby enemy.

name: Light of the Martyr
description: While above 80% health, Holy Shock's healing is increased 20%, but creates a heal absorb on you for 30% of the amount healed that prevents Beacon of Light from healing you until it has dissipated.

name: Light's Conviction
description: Holy Shock now has 2 charges and it refunds 50% of its mana cost when cast on an enemy.

name: Light's Countenance
description: The cooldown of Blinding Light is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Light's Protection
description: Allies with Beacon of Light receive 5% less damage.

name: Light's Revocation
description: Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.\n\nDivine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.

name: Lightbearer
description: 10% of all healing done to you from other sources heals up to 4 nearby allies, divided evenly among them.

name: Lightforged Blessing
description: Shield of the Righteous heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 35.

name: Lingering Radiance
description: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.

name: Luminosity
description: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.

name: Masterwork
description: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 abilities cast a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.

name: Moment of Compassion
description: Your Flash of Light heals for an additional 50% when cast on a target affected by your Beacon of Light.

name: Morning Star
description: Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.\n\nMorning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.

name: Obduracy
description: Speed increased by 2% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 2%.

name: Overflowing Light
description: 30% of Holy Shock's overhealing is converted into an absorb shield. The shield amount cannot exceed 10% of your max health.

name: Pillars of Light
description:
Beacon of Faith:
Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for 125 every 3 sec.

 Beacon of Virtue:
Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for 1,484.

name: Protection of Tyr
description: Aura Mastery also increases all healing received by party or raid members within 40 yards by 10%.

name: Quickened Invocation
description: Divine Toll's, Holy Armament's, and Holy Prism's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Reclamation
description: Holy Shock refunds up to 10% of its Mana cost and deals up to 50% more healing or damage, based on the target's missing health.

name: Recompense
description: After your Blessing of Sacrifice ends, 50% of the total damage it diverted is added to your next Judgment as bonus damage, or your next Word of Glory as bonus healing.\n\nThis effect's bonus damage cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health and its bonus healing cannot exceed 100% of your maximum health.

name: Reflection of Radiance
description: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.

name: Resounding Strike
description: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.

name: Resplendent Light
description: Holy Light heals up to 5 targets within 12 yds for 8% of its healing.

name: Righteous Judgment
description: Judgment has a 100% chance to cast Consecration at the target's location.\n\nThe limit on Consecration does not apply to this effect.

name: Righteous Protection
description: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.

name: Ringing of the Heavens
description: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 100% effectiveness.

name: Rising Sunlight
description: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the average health percentage of allies with your Beacon of Light.

name: Sacred Strength
description: Holy Power spending abilities have 2% increased damage and healing.

name: Sacrifice of the Just
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.

name: Sanctified Plates
description: Armor increased by 10%, Stamina increased by 5% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%.

name: Sanctified Wrath
description: Avenging Wrath and Avenging Crusader have 25% increased duration.

name: Saved by the Light
description: When an ally with your Beacon of Light is damaged, they absorb the next 57 damage, increasing by up to 300% based on their current health. Lower health allies are shielded for more.

name: Seal of Might
description: Mastery increased by 2% and Intellect increased by 2%.

name: Second Sunrise
description: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.

name: Seek Deliverance
description: While Avenging Wrath is not active, you gain 5% Mastery.\n\nWhile Avenging Wrath is active, you gain 30% movement speed.

name: Selfless Healer
description: Flash of Light and Holy Light are 30% more effective on your allies and 40% of the healing done also heals you.

name: Seraphic Barrier
description: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.

name: Shared Resolve
description: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.

name: Shining Righteousness
description: Shield of the Righteous deals 956 damage to its first target struck.\n\nShield of the Righteous now has a 35% chance to activate Divine Purpose if talented.

name: Solar Grace
description: Haste is increased by 5%.

name: Solidarity
description: If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.\n\nIf you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.

name: Stand Against Evil
description: Turn Evil now affects 5 additional enemies.

name: Steed of Liberty
description:
Divine Steed also grants Blessing of Freedom for 3.0 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.

name: Stoicism
description: The duration of stun effects on you is reduced by 20%.

name: Sun Sear
description: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.

name: Sun's Avatar
description: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Tempered in Battle
description: When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.\n\nWhen you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.

name: Tirion's Devotion
description: Lay on Hands' cooldown is reduced by 30% and restores 5% of your Mana.

name: Truth Prevails
description: Judgment heals you for 912 and its mana cost is reduced by 30%. 50% of overhealing from this effect is transferred onto 2 allies within 40 yds.

name: Unbound Freedom
description: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.

name: Unbreakable Spirit
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Lay on Hands by 30%.

name: Unending Light
description: Light of Dawn receives 20% increased benefit from Mastery: Lightbringer.

name: Unwavering Spirit
description: The cooldown of Aura Mastery is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Valiance
description: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.

name: Veneration
description: Judgment grants an absorb shield on up to 5 injured allies for 8% of the damage done, split evenly among them.\n\nFlash of Light and Holy Light critical strikes reset the cooldown of Judgment.

name: Vengeful Wrath
description: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.

name: Walk Into Light
description: Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.

name: Will of the Dawn
description: Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.\n\nWhen your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.
